messages:
Maya (CS): FYI — AcmeCorp opened a ticket saying their trial credits dropped to 0 during yesterday's billing pipeline glitch and they couldn't complete a scheduled load test. They're asking for a credit extension or reinstatement so they can finish evaluation. Ticket #12345.
Samir (Billing): Thanks Maya. Quick policy check: our default is no retroactive credit unless there's a confirmed platform outage or billing error. If there's system-caused loss we can approve a one-off restoration up to the original trial amount. Need evidence and timeline.
Maya (CS): Account ID: acct_8a7f9. Load test ran ~2026-03-09 03:05–03:40 UTC. They claim requests started failing at ~03:25. I've pasted the excerpt they sent below.
Ellie (Support): Can you paste the API request IDs or sample logs? Also did they have any promo codes applied that might have conflicted with trial credits?
Maya (CS): They didn't use a promo. Sample log from the customer (redacted):

```
2026-03-09T03:23:12Z [INFO] request_id=req_01A2 status=500 body="internal_error"
2026-03-09T03:24:05Z [WARN] request_id=req_01A3 status=429 body="rate_limit_exceeded"
2026-03-09T03:25:47Z [ERROR] request_id=req_01A4 status=502 body="bad_gateway"
```

Maya (CS): They say retries were blocked by the CI ramping schedule; total token consumption before failures was ~95% of free trial amount.
Samir (Billing): Ok — please attach support ticket + the customer's logs and I'll start a manual review. If platform shows a billing reconciliation or ingestion lag that caused incorrect consumption accounting, we'll consider reinstating the remainder of their trial. Also need to confirm no abuse patterns.
Kai (Platform Eng): CC'ing from infra: we had a short billing ingestion backlog around 2026-03-09T03:20–03:40Z that temporarily delayed usage reconciliation. It should not drop credits, but it could delay the view in the console. I'll check whether meter events were mis-attributed or dropped. @Samir — if you need the raw usage events I'll pull them.
Samir (Billing): Please do — raw events + reconciliation logs for acct_8a7f9 during 03:00–04:00 UTC. Also want the request_ids to match entries.
Maya (CS): Uploaded the ticket with the customer's full log bundle and the account consent for us to view usage. Link: (internal ticket system) #12345 — note: customer specifically requests a 14-day extension or reinstatement of the remainder of trial credits.
Ellie (Support): I'll update the customer asking for patience and telling them we're investigating. Draft: "Thanks — we're reviewing billing and platform logs. If we confirm the platform backlog impacted your trial usage accounting, we'll restore the remaining trial credits or add a short extension. ETA ~24 hours." OK to send?
Samir (Billing): Good draft, send it. Also add that we may request additional request_ids if any mismatch.
Kai (Platform Eng): Quick note: I already pulled usage events for acct_8a7f9 and there are ~2,400 events between 03:00–03:50. I'm comparing event hashes now; nothing obvious looks dropped but reconciliation timestamps are late by ~8–12 minutes for a subset.
Samir (Billing): If reconciliation was late but events exist we typically won't show a loss of credits (just delayed UI). However, if the customer's client retried with 429/500 and the gateway returned error but we still charged tokens for server-side partial generation, that's a case for manual review. I'll review matched request_ids vs billed tokens.
Maya (CS): Thanks — I'll let the customer know we've started manual review and may restore up to their remaining trial balance if we confirm platform-caused misbilling. Sending now. :thumbsup:
credit-bot: Billing/manual-review started by Samir for acct_8a7f9. Case: billing-review-5582.
Samir (Billing): I'll aim to close with decision in 18–24 hours. If approved, we'll issue either a credit grant equal to the missing tokens or a 14-day extension per customer's request. :eyes:
Ellie (Support): Noted. I'll mark the support ticket as "awaiting billing investigation" and loop in the customer as soon as we have an outcome. :party_parrot:
